The leader of the Real Kindness Squad. She brainwashes others with her words.
This ability, in combination with some additional verbal gymnastics, makes her capable of turning anyone into her mindless puppet.

lines.text: Ugh, this converter feels so constricting around my neck. I'm sure even you think so too.
Hey, you want some Splendamin? The pack is brand new!
I'm a model prisoner, honest.
You're a paragon of virtue, Instructor.
Can't you take this off, even for just a moment? We can keep it between us.
Let's give you some more points, Instructor. Any good ideas?
I'm so bored... Let's chat, Instructor!

Oh, you're abandoning me now that I've been rehabilitated?
You should know better than that, Instructor. 10 points deducted!
The facilities here are really good, and there're loads of people to talk to as well.
How am I doing? Don't worry, everyone here has been nice so far.
A Courthouse? That's fab, everything should be done according to the letter of the law.
I've finally been rehabilitated! To celebrate, here's 10 points!
Thaannnkksss!
At this rate, I'll be the strongest one here at the Outpost.
Hahaha! That's it! More, more!
You don't have to give me this...

A token of your appreciation?
I'm so touched... 30 points for you!
Thanks, I'm grateful and all, but... material things aren't everything.
Now we're talking!
I've never met anyone like you before, Instructor.
You've been taking great care of me lately, Instructor. It's incredibly laudable, so here's 30 points for you!
Time for some community service...
Where should I work at?
Hopefully, I hit pay dirt.
Let's go earn some points, kids!
Imagine... me, contributing to society.
Can we be real for a sec?
Jeez, these guys are even worse than me!
Reloading!
Argh!
What should I have for dinner tonight?
Can I take it off now, Instructor?
I have something to say. Wanna hear it?
Ready? Let's serve up some street justice.
Hahaha!
Bang! Bang!
Let's get to work.
Ugh...
That hurts!
Yeouch!
Sigh... they were too much for me...
See that? There's nothing you can't solve with words.
Doesn't this mask seem kind of easy to take off?
Working part-time as a maid isn't so bad. Isn't that right, Master?

A spell to make it delicious?
I'm not quite sure about that. I'm still in training.

My mask? It's pretty comfortable as it is.
But... if you want to take it off, that would be a different story, wouldn't it?
What shall we do together today, Master?

Coochie woochie... What's the next part again?
Maybe it'll come back to me if you pick me again.
Doing nothing does make me feel a little guilty.

Are you leaving me alone again? That's 50 penalty points!
But, since you've been nice to me lately... you get 50 bonus points too.
Feel free to take this flyer, even if you end up tossing it later.
*Sigh*... Should I just go back to the Rehabilitation Center?

My work hours are a secret.
If you're curious, come find me at the Maid Cafe.

I've been rehabilitated, and have been working hard as a part-time maid.
I'm doing great, so you'll pick me, won't you?
Thank you, Master.
I was tired, but now I feel energized.
How thoughtful of you. Thank you.
Wow, what's this? Thanks.
It's against the rules here, but I'll accept a gift, just this once.
If you keep giving me things like this, I might get the wrong impression, you know?
I like you too, Master♡
So, you really like me, huh? Whatever should I do?
To be honest, this makes me quite happy. Perhaps I should give you the privilege of choosing me?
Maybe I was better off back at the Rehabilitation Center...
Yes, Master.
I'll take your order.
My goodness, what a rude customer!
The ever-so-well-mannered maid is on the job.
So many customers again today.
Any rude customers will be asked to leave.
Let's take a quick break.
There's no end to this.
I've got another job after this...
Should I get serious now?
Do you want to be a maid too? Ahahaha.
Let's teach these rude customers a lesson.
One down.
Become delicious!
Onto the next annoying customer.
Ergh!
Ow!
Ouch...
Dang, all the customers are from hell...
I worked so hard fighting them. You'll give me 50 bonus points, right?
